title: The receiver decides
subtitle: Receive what you want. The receiver's order travels inside the BOLT12 offer; the payer sees their choice next to the cheapest route.
footer: KaleidoPay · Rate on iOS · mainnet quotes, nothing paid · bitcoin++ Berlin 2026
note: Mainnet quotes · nothing paid in this demo

steps.title: A receiver who wants bitcoin on-chain
steps.body: Same shop, different preference: on-chain first, then Lightning, then Bark.

steps.title: Scan and quote
steps.body: KaleidoPay decodes the rails and asks every route for a price.

steps.title: Their order, on screen
steps.body: On-chain · Lightning · Bark. The preference travels inside the offer, set when the receiver's node issued it.

steps.title: You still see the cheapest
steps.body: Bark to their Bark address costs nothing, so it is preselected and marked Best price.

steps.title: Their choice vs best price
steps.body: Their first choice is marked too, and swap providers found on Nostr are listed for on-chain.

steps.title: Pay their way
steps.body: Pick their choice: Bark sends on-chain through Second's server, with the fee shown up front.
